name: Losartan
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Losartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), needs no dose change for kidney impairment alone per the US label, unless the patient is also volume depleted. Neither losartan nor its active metabolite is removed by hemodialysis.
kidney_function_basis: Label PK uses creatinine clearance (CrCl); dosing statement is not band-specific.

bands.recommendation: Usual dosing: 50 mg once daily, up to 100 mg once daily.
No adjustment unless volume depleted (label). Exposure is 50 to 90% higher in mild to moderate impairment.
No adjustment unless volume depleted (label). Monitor potassium and creatinine.
No label adjustment; monitor potassium, creatinine and blood pressure closely.
bands.short: No change; monitor K, Cr, BP

hd.text: No adjustment in the label; not removed by hemodialysis.

pd.text: No data in label. Insufficient PD-specific data; no label adjustment.
pd.short: Insufficient PD data; no label change

dialyzable: No: neither losartan nor its active metabolite is removed by hemodialysis (label).
monitoring: Serum creatinine and potassium after starting or changing dose; correct volume depletion before starting (label warnings on hypotension and renal function changes).

pediatric.approved_ages: Hypertension, 6 to 16 years (label). Not established under 6 years or with GFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2.
pediatric.usual_dose: 0.7 mg/kg once daily (up to 50 mg); doses above 1.4 mg/kg (or above 100 mg) daily have not been studied (label).
pediatric.max_dose: 1.4 mg/kg/day, not to exceed 100 mg/day (studied range per label).

renal.recommendation: Usual pediatric dose (no label adjustment); monitor potassium and creatinine.

pediatric.neonates: Neonates: not recommended (under 6 years). In utero exposure: support blood pressure and renal perfusion if oliguria or hypotension.
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)

sources.citation: Organon LLC. (2026). COZAAR (losartan potassium) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA020386, set ID 9949448f-c3b9-44ee-94ed-c1aca8c90f39, version effective January 20, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

adult: Label gives a single statement (no adjustment unless volume depleted) without bands; band text is that statement repeated with monitoring.
pediatric: Label threshold is 'GFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m2' without naming an equation; bedside Schwartz used for the site's bands.
